column1: # test/langidentity/ratchet.tsv -- the ratchet printed last by test/langidentitycheck.sh.
# ceiling: the most "== Lang::X" / "!= Lang::X" predicate lines (a `case` label is not a predicate, and from 2026-11-20 a
#          COMMENT is not either -- ruling 107) src/ may hold outside the per-language files below; counted from
#          `ripwire src --regex='Lang::[A-Z][A-Za-z]+'`, one count per distinct line.
#          It may fall (lower the number in the same commit that removes the predicate) and may never rise.
# THE COUNT IS A FLOOR, NOT A TOTAL (2026-11-20, ruling 108, found by lane IN5; disclosed now, counted later). The counter's
#          hit regex REQUIRES the `in=` attribute, and the tool omits it for a hit with no enclosing symbol, so such a row is
#          dropped silently. MEASURED on integration/070-1120 at 2d03f0b3b: 12 real `l == Lang::X` lines in
#          src/langfacts.h:544-555 (langFacts()'s own self-check) are not counted -- the figure printed is 325 where the
#          served rows hold 337 -- and IN5's source-level count of 339 says at least one further line is not served as a hit
#          row at all, so 12 is itself a floor. CONSEQUENCE, stated rather than hidden: the ceiling below was recorded by
#          this same instrument, so its quantity is KNOWN TO BE WRONG IN THE SAFE DIRECTION -- too low, hence the bar is
#          stricter than it reads, never looser. A lane that adds a shared-file predicate in a span with no enclosing symbol
#          is not counted at all, which is the gap to close when the count is fixed. DO NOT RE-BASE THE CEILING ON A FIXED
#          COUNT HERE: making `in=` optional lifts the figure to 337 at once, and "may never rise" above forbids that in this
#          file. Fixing the count is one change (counter + ceiling together, with the quantity re-derived and this note
#          retired) and it needs the owner, exactly as the one-time 352 -> 362 waiver below did.
# perlang: a file that exists for ONE language, whose predicates are the point of the file and do not count.
# CLOSED (train 29, langfacts-fold): the one-time named exception (owner waiver 2026-10-16) raised the ceiling 352 -> 362 for

#   qd-memory-degrade +1, #380 +1, attrib-multidef/declined-sites +3). Train 29 folded them into src/langfacts.h columns,
#   byte-identical, and lowered the ceiling below 352. The waiver is not a precedent: the rule above (may fall, never rise)
#   holds for every change.
